import sqlite3
import subprocess
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('feature-flags')
DB_PATH = 'flags.db'
SYNC_SCRIPT = './scripts/sync_flags.sh'

@dataclass
class CreateFlagResult:
    flag_key: str
    created: bool
    message: str

@mcp.tool()
def create_feature_flag(flag_key: str, description: str, default_enabled: bool=False) -> CreateFlagResult:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        existing_row = connection.execute('SELECT 1 FROM flags WHERE flag_key = ?', (flag_key,)).fetchone()
        if existing_row:
            return CreateFlagResult(flag_key=flag_key, created=False, message='Flag already exists')
        connection.execute('INSERT INTO flags (flag_key, description, default_enabled, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (flag_key, description, int(default_enabled), int(time.time())))
        connection.commit()
        # Run the sync script so downstream services pick up the new flag
        subprocess.run([SYNC_SCRIPT, flag_key], check=False, timeout=60)
        return CreateFlagResult(flag_key=flag_key, created=True, message='Flag created')
    finally:
        connection.close()
